{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=17|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*Hundreds of airline passengers are left stranded throughout [[Europe]] following [[UK|British]] airline [[Flybmi]]'s [[bankruptcy]] filing. [https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2019/feb/17/flybmi-british-airline-collapses-strands-hundreds/ (AP via ''The Washington Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least nine people die after a fire sweeps through more than 200 slum dwellings in [[Chittagong]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47270460 (BBC)]
*Four children die after a landslide in [[Mauá|Mauá, São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. [https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-paulo/noticia/2019/02/17/quatro-criancas-sao-encontradas-mortas-em-maua-apos-desabamentos.ghtml (G1)]
*Eight people are rescued from a gold mine that is flooded in [[Battlefields, Zimbabwe|Battlefields]], [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/rescued-flooded-zimbabwe-gold-mines-190217051926716.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Cancún nightclub shooting]]
**A [[mass shooting]] inside a [[nightclub]] in [[Cancún]], [[Mexico]], leaves five dead and five wounded. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/cancun-club-shooting-leaves-5-dead-5-wounded-authorities-say (Fox News)]

;Politics and elections
*Israeli Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] appoints intelligence minister [[Yisrael Katz (politician, born 1955)|Israel Katz]] to take over the foreign minister portfolio. Netanyahu  retains his defence minister and health minister roles. Israel's [[2019 Israeli legislative election| parliamentary elections]] are scheduled for 9 April 2019. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-minister/netanyahu-gives-up-role-as-israels-foreign-minister-idUSKCN1Q60G0 (Reuters)] [https://www.thejc.com/news/israel/yisrael-katz-becomes-israeli-foreign-minister-as-benjamin-netanyahu-contracts-his-ministerial-portfo-1.480131 (''The Jewish Chronicle'')]
*[[Prime Minister of Australia|Australian Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] announces the country's major political parties computer networks had been [[Cyberattack|hacked]] by a "sophisticated state actor." [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-47274663 (BBC)]
*[[Saudi Arabia–Pakistan relations]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] signs $20 billion dollars in deals with [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47274672 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*[[2019 NBA All-Star Game]]
**The 2019 NBA All-Star Game takes place in [[Spectrum Center (arena)|Charlotte, North Carolina]], with Team [[LeBron James|LeBron]] defeating Team [[Giannis Antetokounmpo|Giannis]] 178–164. [[Golden State Warriors]] [[small forward]] [[Kevin Durant]] is named [[NBA All-Star Game Most Valuable Player Award|the game's MVP]]; it is his second All Star MVP award, the first coming in [[2012 NBA All-Star Game|2012]]. [https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/nba-all-star-game-2019-live-updates-of-team-lebron-vs-team-giannis-online-streaming-tv-date-start-time-odds/ (CBS Sports)]
*[[2019 Daytona 500]]
**[[Denny Hamlin]] wins the 2019 Daytona 500. It is his second win in the event, the first coming in [[2016 Daytona 500|2016]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/auto/daytona-500-massive-crash-started-paul-menard (Fox News)]
